_comment: The shape of outputs/rules.json. Every numbered clause in policy.md goes in exactly one of rules or excluded.

rules.quote: A receipt must be attached to any claim of $25 or more.

excluded.reason: Says what the policy is for. Nothing is required of anyone.

_fields.quote: Copied from policy.md word for word. Never shortened, fixed or reworded.
_fields.threshold_low: The amount a claim must be over (or at, if inclusive) for the rule to apply. A number, or null.
_fields.threshold_high: The most that is allowed. A number, or null. Two limits in one clause: one rule per limit.
_fields.inclusive: true when the policy says 'or more', 'up to', 'within'; false when it says 'over', 'longer than'. null when there is no threshold.
_fields.unit: USD, USD per person, USD per night, days or hours.
_fields.approver: The role that must approve or pre-approve (manager, director, vice president), or null.
_fields.action: What someone must do, in a few plain words (attach a receipt, get director approval, list attendees).
_fields.parameters: Figures the policy names but does not give, as {"name": null}. Never fill one in from memory.
